Tsuneo finisce per seguirle nella squallida abitazione che condividono, e nonostante il guscio in cui Kimiko sembra essersi rinchiusa, comincerà a farsi vivo sempre più spesso.

episodes.title: Syr / " "
episodes.synopsis: La Famiglia Estia festeggia alla taverna il ritorno dalla spedizione quando Syr decide di fare la propria mossa nei confronti di Bell, sfruttando l'occasione del festival delle dee per invitarlo ad un'uscita a due.

episodes.title: Master / Addestratore
episodes.synopsis: In preparazione alla sua uscita con Syr, Bell viene rapito da Hedin che è deciso a sfruttare i giorni prima del festival delle dee per trasformare il giovane coniglio scapestrato in un gentiluomo di tutto rispetto.

episodes.title: Odr / Compagno
episodes.synopsis: Dopo aver seminato i pedinatori della Famiglia Freya, Bell e Syr continuano il loro appuntamento in solitaria, visitando prima un duomo dedicato a un'antica epica e poi cenando su un ristorante galleggiante. È proprio lì che tutti i loro inseguitori li trovano e scoppia il finimondo.

episodes.title: Seidhr / Dea e Figlia
episodes.synopsis: Rifugiatisi in un albergo, Bell e Syr si trovano a dormire sullo stesso letto, mentre quest'ultima confida a mezza voce i propri sentimenti. La mattina dopo Bell si sveglia da solo e va a cercarla, ma viene guidato da Ottar a una Syr diversa da quella che conosce.

episodes.title: Famiglia Freya / Aggressione
episodes.synopsis: Dopo aver respinto Syr, Bell si confronta con Ryu sulle proprie ragioni. Nel frattempo Estia cova dubbi sulla reale identità di Syr, quando Freya la ferma per strada intimandole di cederle Bell. Dopo il rifiuto di Estia, Freya ordina ai propri Figli di attaccare la Famiglia Estia e rapire Bell. Infine, convinta da Ermes, rinuncia alla conversione ma procede a usare il proprio fascino sulla città.

episodes.title: Orario / Città distorta
episodes.synopsis: Freya ha usato il potere del proprio fascino di dea della bellezza per cambiare la percezione di Bell per tutti gli abitanti di Orario, divinità comprese. Il giovane si troverà così a confrontarsi con una realtà differente da quella che ricorda, dove è considerato uno dei brutali membri della Famiglia Freya, senza che neppure i suoi compagni fidati lo riconoscano.

episodes.title: Loneliness / L'addio
episodes.synopsis: Bell si sta adeguando alla vita a Folkvangr, mentre Freya scava sempre più a fondo nel suo animo per cercare di vincerlo. Nel frattempo Asfi e Ryu tornano in città, e quest'ultima scorge Anya che segue il fratello fino da Freya, che svela la propria identità di Syr. Segue uno scontro verbale che vede la sconfitta di tutte le parti in campo.

episodes.title: Bell Cranel / Brama
episodes.synopsis: Bell ormai è abbattuto e sta per perdersi d'animo, affidandosi al tepore della dea Freya, ma in un ultimo atto di ribellione si confronta con la fonte della sua ammirazione, Aiz, che risveglia in lui la convinzione di resistere. Nel frattempo Estia entra in contatto con Asfi mentre Ermes si cruccia per venire a capo della situazione bizzarra in cui si trova.

episodes.title: Vesta / Altare della sacra fiamma
episodes.synopsis: Bell ha finalmente ritrovato sé stesso e sta pensando al futuri quando Folkvangr è scossa da un'esplosione causata da Ryu che sta seminando il panico per la Casa. Bell segue Horn che, dopo averlo accusato per la sua insensibilità, gli restituisce il pugnale di Estia e lo usa per autoinfliggersi una ferita. Poi, trasformatasi in Syr fa promettere a Bell di salvare Freya.

episodes.title: War game / Guerra tra fazioni
episodes.synopsis: Estia accetta il War game proposto da Freya e, dopo aver deciso che si tratterà di uno scontro a nascondino tra la Famiglia Freya e una coalizione di varie altre Famiglie, Lili inizia a stilare la strategia con l'aiuto di Finn. Nel mentre le Famiglie di Orario devono decidere se schierarsi nello scontro o astenersi. Inoltre viene impedito alla Famiglia Loki di partecipare.

episodes.title: Folkvangr / Inferno
episodes.synopsis: Con l'inizio del War game le forze della coalizione si trovano confuse a scoprire che la Famiglia Freya si è barricata invece di partire all'attacco, forzando così uno scontro tra le due fazioni. La situazione volge al peggio per la coalizione e nonostante Bell riesca a incontrare Ottar come pianificato, l'avventuriero più forte di Orario si rivela essere troppo per il giovane coniglio.

episodes.title: Astrea Record / Eredità
episodes.synopsis: Tutto sembra perduto per la coalizione dopo l'attacco improvviso da parte della Famiglia Freya, quando il vento predetto da Cassandra si palesa sotto forma di Ryu salita ora a livello 6 dopo aver ritrovato la dea Astrea. Nel mentre Bell si convince a combattere Ottar lasciandosi alle spalle la disperazione.

episodes.title: Revenge / Contrattacco
episodes.synopsis: Col tradimento di Hedin la situazione sul campo si ribalta, permettendo alle forze della coalizione di passare in vantaggio. Ryu raggiunge Bell nello scontro contro Ottar, e anche Mia si unisce alla lotta.

episodes.title: Einherjar / I guerrieri della dea
episodes.synopsis: Hedin convince Hogni a seguirlo nel tradimento, così quest'ultimo va ad aiutare Anya nel suo scontro col fratello Allen. Nel frattempo la battaglia contro Ottar sembra volgere in favore di Bell e compagni grazie all'arrivo di Hedin, ma Ottar dimostra di meritare il titolo di Sovrano schiacciando la loro resistenza.

episodes.title: Syr / Primo amore
episodes.synopsis: Lo scontro con Ottar si conclude grazie al sacrificio di tutti e Bell corre da Freya cercando di non farsi raggiungere da Allen. Trovandosi a dover rifiutare un'altra volta il suo amore, pone fine al War Game. La Gilda scioglie così la Famiglia Freya, ma alla dea è concesso rimanere in città come Syr.

info.title: Tokyo Override
info.synopsis: La storia è ambientata 100 anni nel futuro, in una Tokyo ormai ottimizzata sulla base dell'intelligenza artificiale. Una giovane hacker viene inavvertitamente trascinata all'interno di una banda motociclistica, finendo con l'essere coinvolta in un caso di omicidio. Ciò la porterà a conoscere il lato più sinistro di questa utopica città futuristica.

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.synopsis: During the Earth Federation's assault on the Zeon's A Baoa Qu fortress, Io and his comrades escape captivity while several Zeon forces retreat, taking Io's Gundam with them. Eight months after the end of the One Year War, the Federation continues to battle Zeon remnants on Earth. The Federation carrier Spartan enters Earth orbit, but a Musai-class ship launches its Komusai shuttle for a kamikaze run on it. Suddenly, a new Gundam piloted by Io is launched from below and it slices the Komusai in half to save the Spartan.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.synopsis: The South Seas Alliance, a Buddhist radical cult faction of the Federation, plots to declare itself independent. Furthermore, it is discovered that they possess the Reuse P. Device technology of Daryl's Psycho Zaku. The Spartan is assigned to track and destroy the Psycho Zaku before the South Seas Alliance can mass-produce the technology. In Antarctica, Bianca's squadron is ambushed by Zeon mobile suits. Io sorties in the Atlas Gundam and dispatches the enemy units before facing a Grublo mobile armor. The battle sends both units far too deep underwater and Io with his equipment lost slowly sinks to the bottom of the sea, but Bianca in her damaged Guncannon Aqua lifts him back to the surface.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.synopsis: Due to the emotional trauma Karla suffered during the One Year War, her mind has regressed back to that of an adolescent child with the Zeon Remnants now trying to take care of her in hopes of her adult mind to recover. Daryl's Acguy squadron heads to a South Seas Alliance-controlled city in Southeast Asia to retrieve a spy, but their cover is blown and they must fend off against the island's mobile Suits. Meanwhile, the Spartan is confronted by a South Seas Alliance mobile suit Squadron, with Io's former commander and lover Claudia leading them.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.synopsis:
Having entered the jungle, the Acguy team finds itself in a fierce battle with the South Seas Alliance's Dahle forces. Refusing to abandon his mission of contacting the spy, Daryl is backed into a corner.
Meanwhile, the South Seas Alliance's border garrison has deployed Goufs and Do-dais to block the Spartan's path. As they resort to suicide attacks in an attempt to break into the ship, what are they trying to achieve?
In order to confirm the identity of the garrison commander, who gives her name as Claudia Peer, Io boards a GM Ground Type-C and fights together with Bianca's Corvette Booster. Intercepting the Goufs and Do-dais, they take them down one by one. The three-way fighting continues to intensify, in the dense jungle and at high altitude...

info.title: Eternal Alice
info.synopsis: Kirihara Aruto è un grande appassionato di Alice e delle storie a lei dedicate, tanto da scrivere lui stesso la sua propria versione di Alice. Una notte intravede dalla finestra, al chiaro di luna, una ragazza che a prima vista identifica proprio come la sua amata Alice e che decide di seguire. Improvvisamente si ritrova coinvolto in una battaglia tra due ragazze vestite in maniera bizzarra, che termina con la vittoria di quella intravista da Aruto, che subito si impossessa del libro nascosto nel cuore dell'avversaria. Il giorno successivo Aruto, ancora stordito dall'evento, viene avvicinato da Arisu Arisugawa (per chi non lo sapesse Arisu ha la stessa pronuncia, per i giapponesi, dell'inglese di Alice) che si rivela essere la misteriosa ragazza vista la sera prima e per di più una "cercatrice di Alice". Arisu è interessata ad Aruto per via della sua capacità di entrare nel merveilleux space, la particolare dimensione dove le cercatrici di Alice si incontrano e combattono tra loro allo scopo di ricomporre il libro leggendario della Eterna Alice. Ennesimo adattamento da un manga del celebre duo composto da Hitoshi Ota e Terumasa Shichinohe, meglio conosciuti sotto il nome di Kaishaku. I due sono oramai famosissimi per i loro personaggi femminili, formosi o semplicemente graziosi che siano, votati a soddisfare i canoni estetici degli otaku più svariati, in base ad un vero e proprio sfoggio di feticismo, barocco di particolari di ogni genere.

info.title: I'm Gonna Be an Angel!
info.synopsis: La storia parla di un ragazzo che avendo guadagnato da poco l'indipendenza dalla famiglia sogna un brillante avvenire... ma non ha ancora fatto i conti con una strana ragazza che trova nuda in un boschetto e che dichiarerà di essere sua moglie! Non solo, infatti lei è quasi a tutti gli effetti un angelo con tanto di aureola e come se non bastasse il nostro povero Yuusuke dovrà vederesela con la particolare famiglia di lei.. nonchè con in nemici che cominceranno ad attaccarli per portarsi via l'adorabile angioletto!

episodes.title: I like kisses... I think
episodes.synopsis: Yuusuke's father has moved abroad, and now Yuusuke has the house to himself. However, on his way to school, he stumbles upon (actually, falls on top of) a naked, sleeping girl in the forest, with a halo over her head. He runs away when she wakes up and declares that he's her husband, but he can't escape her - she's the new student in his class! Noelle follows Yuusuke home, and he discovers that her family of demons from the underworld have moved in - and redecorated.

episodes.title: An Unperfect love is fine with me!
episodes.synopsis: Yuusuke is in love with his classmate Natsumi, who's on the diving team. She's a bit standoffish and doesn't take to him, especially after a couple of accidental incidents convince her that he's a pervert. He tells Natsumi that she's like an angel to him, but she rebuffs him. Noelle overhears this conversation and decides she's going to become an angel for Yuusuke. Meanwhile, Papa is trying to find a job and ends up promoting a wrestling champion named Delicious White. The family finds out that Deli-chan is actually working for a demon named Dispell, who has an unhealthy obsession with Noelle. Deli-chan kidnaps Noelle, and Yuusuke and the family have to rescue her.

episodes.title: Hug Me Tightly
episodes.synopsis: Dispell, the villain, doesn't want Noelle to become an angel. To him, beauty lies in imperfection, and a haloed angel with no wings is beautiful and imperfect. He sends another demon, the cat-girl Miruru, to make sure Noelle doesn't succeed in becoming an angel, while his companion Silky sits passively by and echoes his lunatic ravings. Miruru obliges, though she'd much rather chase after Gabriel, Noelle's vampire older brother who has a terrible allergy to cats.

episodes.title: Precious Things... Precious
episodes.synopsis: Yuusuke has developed a cold, and Noelle wants to make him feel better. Although she'd rather stay by him, he convinces her to go to school, where his friends Masaru and Saiki remark that he's lucky to have someone who thinks he's precious. Noelle doesn't know what the word "precious" means and tries to find out in class. Her teacher tells her that when you think someone is precious, it means you want them to find happiness. Miruru catches Noelle after school and tries to persuade her to go to a fancy restaurant with her, promising it will bring her true happiness. Noelle becomes extremely happy when she samples the dessert, Jasmine Jelly (it's pururun!), and decides to take it home to Yuusuke right away. Once she leaves the restaurant uproots itself and chases after her, trying to capture her to give her to Dispell. The restaurant is distracted by a giant cake and leaves Noelle alone - though it managed to smash her Jasmine Jelly before she could get it to Yuusuke.

episodes.title: Invisible, But Still Here
episodes.synopsis: Noelle's oldest sister, Sara, is invisible. At first she enjoyed being invisible, because people left her alone, but now she can't make herself visible again and feels alienated. While the rest of the family plays a mean game of beach volleyball, Sara meets Yuusuke at the beach, wrapped in bandages. She said he was the first person who's paid attention to her in a long time, and she could make herself visible in front of him. The two of them are interrupted when a UFO kidnaps Noelle. Yuusuke runs to save her, and Sara has to get help from the rest of the family - if she can get their attention, that is.

episodes.title: Heart with Wings, Kinda
episodes.synopsis: Because she wants to be Yuusuke's angel, Noelle starts her flying attempts, with the help of mechanical wings built by her sister Lucca. We see through flashback Natsumi's traumatizing memory of losing her older brother, Fuyuki. She's bitter about his death and is very annoyed with Noelle for endlessly talking about angels, but still Noelle follows her around and demands that Natsumi teach her how to fly. She goes to the diving team with Natsumi and attempts to dive off the high diving board the way Natsumi does. After all, Yuusuke said Natsumi was an angel, and every morning he watches her "fly" off the diving board.

episodes.title: Scratched Relationship... Kinda
episodes.synopsis: A package arrives for Yuusuke --it's a squid! With a halo over her head! The family decides how they're going to cook her, until the squid announces they can't do that -- she's Noelle! After all, Noelle's family is not blood related, so what difference does it make if another Noelle moves in with them? She commences usurping Noelle's seat at the dinner table, Noelle's rice bowl, and Noelle's bedroom. To keep the family together Papa goes out and buys squid Noelle her own rice bowl. She's so touched that she confesses to Papa that she's not Noelle at all, much to Miruru's chagrin. Miruru asked her to disrupt the family and get rid of Noelle, presumably to drive her to Dispell.

episodes.title: I Miss You So Much, It Hurts
episodes.synopsis: In the first episode, Noelle and her family had to battle a giant rice-cooking Daruma, sent by Dispell, using a mecha built by Lucca. Now Lucca has updated the mecha and Noelle is the designated pilot. Meanwhile, Miruru convinces the Daruma's wife (with baby in tow) to wreak vengeance upon the family for taking her husband away. The Daruma's wife proceeds to attack Noelle, who refuses to fight back - she understands that it's painful to be separated from the one you love. Sara suggests they bring the Daruma back to life, so that there will be no reason for revenge anymore.

episodes.title: No Is Not No
episodes.synopsis: Granny doesn't want Noelle to marry an "impure human" so she goes off in a huff when the family starts discussing marriage plans (ignoring Yuusuke's objections). Miruru and Granny team up to try and get Yuusuke out of the picture (Miruru telling Granny that she loves Yuusuke and wants him for herself). So the newest robot has a ukulele that can turn people into frogs. Slowly each family member is turned into a cute little frog until Yuusuke is the only one left (Miruru betrayed Granny so even she is a frog) and has to figure out how to save everyone. He thinks you have to look into the ukulele's eyes but it's the strings that hold the magic.

episodes.title: That Which Is Visible, Beyond The Hole
episodes.synopsis: Natsumi has a fight with Kai. Yuusuke and Noelle go to a festival and Noelle receives a little creature called Bunbun ("Boonboon"), who supposedly will turn into a angel with 7 color wings if it's taken care of properly. Yuusuke has a bad feeling about the little guy though since it refuses to let Noelle sleep in Yuusuke's room and she even left for school without him the next morning. When it goes cray and eats all the food at the table when Noelle runs off to get some napkins, Yuusuke is convinces Bunbun is bas news, but Noelle refuses to believe him. When Yuusuke yells at her to get rid of it, Noelle seems like she's about to say "I hate you!" but instead says "I still love you!" so Miruru pops out, disappointed that her plan to break up Yuusuke and Noelle didn't work. Bunbun then goes berserk and drills holes into the walls of the house, making the whole thing look like Swiss cheese. Bunbun goes after Noelle and Yuusuke saves her. Lucca then fixes the old Bunbun into a proper, non-evil, creature and Noelle celebrates.

episodes.title: An Unexpected Goodbye
episodes.synopsis: A comet is coming and it's got Mikael worried for Noelle. Yuusuke and Natsumi are chosen to be the class representatives on the committee for the school's Durian festival to celebrate the comet (that looks like a durian fruit). Yuusuke has a chat with Kai, learning about the relationship between Kai, Natsumi, and Natsumi's dead brother Fuyuki. Kai was always in love with Natsumi but she only ever saw him as Fuyuki's friend, then when Fuyuki died she started to hang around Kai more (likely using him as a replacement for Fuyuki). Mikael speaks to Yuusuke, telling him to not let Noelle out of his sight and Yuusuke goes to find her. She's with Lucca at the school's clock tower, they were going to use the comets power to help Noelle fly, but the clock started to wing backwards, catching the hose attached to Noelle's mechanical wings and lifting her into the air. Yuusuke arrives just then and helps get her down before running up the clock tower to see what was happening. When he gets there, he finds Natsumi, but she's become a child again!

episodes.title: To Love is to be Loved?
episodes.synopsis: Child Natsumi is staying with Yuusuke and the others at his house. He tells the school he, Noelle, and Natsumi all got sick and his friends take over the committee positions, but they're not buying the sudden sickness and pay Yuusuke a visit. So Yuusuke comes clean and tells them about Natsumi and his friends say they'll help him cover it up as long as he can find the cure. Yuusuke tries to take Natsumi back to the clock tower to find clues but she refuses and runs off. Later, Noelle remembers seeing Natsumi at a grave and that's where they find her. Yuusuke tries to explain to Natsumi that she has to let her brother go, he's never coming back, and she'll stay a child forever if she can't accept that, but all this does is make Natsumi mad at and scared of Yuusuke. She retreats into the (weird) hole in Yuusuke's room, covering it with cardboard and refusing to come out, throwing stuff at Yuusuke when he tries to go in. Meanwhile, Noelle is practicing on the room of the school with the heavy mechanical wings for the day the comet comes. Sara and Gabriel seem a little concerned that Yuusuke is spending so much time and energy on Natsumi, and Lucca tries to point out to Noelle that Yuusuke would probably rather become Natsumi's angel than for Noelle to become him, but Noelle doesn't seem to understand what Lucca is trying to say. On the day of the festival, Yuusuke is fed up with Natsumi hiding and goes to get her out, but she's ready and runs up to the roof. Yuusuke has a heart to heart with her, he explained how at first he thought they had the same kind of sadness over losing people they love, but he'd realized that they were different pains after all (since he is still able to actually see and speak to his parents since they're not dead, unlike Natsumi's brother). Yuusuke and Natsumi both decide to make a wish on the Durian comet to wish for Natusmi to be able to see Fuyuki again.

episodes.title: Coming Full Circle, With a Little Detour
episodes.synopsis: At the festival, Granny is running a fortune telling stand. She sees Mikael walking past and invites him in. We discover that Granny knows who Mikael is (or at least knows he's been encouraging Noelle's endeavor to become an angel) and tells him to leave Noelle alone. Yuusuke and child-Natsumi are on their way to the festival to make their wish. Miruru is confronted by Dispel, who has come to capture Noelle himself. He tries to kill Miruru but Gabriel steps in and saves her. He realizes that he's not itchy and theorizes that since he drank Miruru's blood (a few episodes ago) he's immune to his cat allergy now. The comet is over head and Noelle is preparing to run like her and Lucca had been practicing, when Dispel drops in and throws Lucca through the clock tower before chasing after Noelle who tried to run away. Yuusuke and Natsumi had been on their way to the top of the clock tower to make their wish when Lucca came crashing through. Yuusuke's friends and their teacher see Dispel going after Noelle and throw their durian's at him to try and slow him down. Noelle and Dispel end up at the top of the clock tower. Yuusuke tries to help but gets blown off the building. He's trying to hold on to both the building and Natsumi while Disple tries to kick him off. Yuusuke and Natumi fall and Noelle jumps after them. There's a flash of light, Noelle's halo flashing and expanding, and her mechanical wings take flight, enabling her to save Yuusuke and Natusmi, all three of them safely landing on the ground. Disple, believing that he failed in preventing Noelle from becoming an angel, leaves. Natsumi, who had a vision of her brother telling her to let him go and move on, has turned back into her normal self to Yuusuke's relief. Back at the lair, Dispel is upset and Silky, his supposed slave, tells him Noelle isn't an angel yet and says she's bored now. She was apparently in charge the whole time, Dispel just being a doll. info.title: Lupin III - Il tesoro degli Zar (ITA)
info.synopsis: Lupin e Jigen sono alla ricerca di informazioni sullo zar Nicola II. La storia parla chiaro, la Russia intorno al 1916 era in possesso del 20% dell'oro mondiale ma, nonostante ciò, la popolazione soffriva fame e povertà. Durante la rivoluzione russa, venne giustiziata la famiglia Romanov e Lupin, andando avanti con le ricerche, scopre che in realtà i Romanov sono stati graziati da una guardia della sicurezza che, per ricompensa, riceve 500 tonnellate di oro. Il nostro ladro, allora, scopre il posto in cui è nascosto il tesoro, ovvero Sant'Antonio, Texas. Giunto lì insieme a Jigen e Fujiko, ruba l'imponente ricchezza e fugge. I tre riusciranno a farla franca, nonostante i numerosi impedimenti e pericoli?

info.title: Noein: To Your Other Self
info.synopsis: In un iper-tecnologico futuro, il mondo di Lacryma è minacciato da un attacco proveniente da un’altra dimensione: Shangri-La. Un solo elemento è in grado di fermare l’avanzata del potente nemico: la misteriosa Catena del Drago. Ma che cos’è in realtà? Un oggetto? Una persona? O qualcosa d’altro ancora? I novelli crociati dell’Ordine del Drago vengono inviati alla sua ricerca, viaggiando nel tempo e nello spazio fino al nostro presente, in cui la dodicenne Haruka sta progettando di scappare di casa insieme all’amico Yu. L’incontro con un Cavaliere del Drago di nome Karasu cambierà i suoi piani: l’uomo infatti è convinto che Haruka sia legata alla mistica Catena

episodes.title: Blue Snow
episodes.synopsis: Haruka Kaminogi’s plan to spend summer break goofing off with her friends gets derailed when she begins having visions of blue snow and strange figures.

episodes.title: Hunted

episodes.title: Friends
episodes.synopsis: Some misunderstanding is created between Haruka's and Isami's relationship that causes some inner hatred from Ai. Now, it seems Haruka has to weld it back together again.

episodes.title: And Then...
episodes.synopsis: Atori, Tobi, and Isuka, travel onto the present time-space in order to destroy Haruka.

episodes.title: Dimension of Tears
episodes.synopsis: Haruka is taken to La'cryma. She managed to escape and mix herself up with the residents at the local town. When she reaches the surface, she notices many similar things related to her world.

episodes.title: Precious Person
episodes.synopsis: Haruka is finally being used by La'cryma for their own diabolical reasons, but Karasu has other plans.

episodes.title: Secrets
episodes.synopsis: Haruka returns to her present time-space and invites Karasu to live with her after he unplugged his pipeline. Though little did she expect she would get involved with Yuu's relationship problems with his mother.

episodes.title: Beyond Time
episodes.synopsis: Yuu's mother causes a disruption in time-spaces, which causes her to wander down in memory lane. It is up to Haruka to use her powers and save her.

episodes.title: A Stormy Night
episodes.synopsis: Atori makes one final attempt to destroy the Dragon Torque, but is stopped by Karasu. However, Atori is not the only one who wants Haruka.

episodes.title: Out of Sync
episodes.synopsis: Yuu has decided to make it his goal to study in Tokyo, but Isami is in disagreement with him. Fukurou and Karasu are preparing themselves for a similar type of fight.

episodes.title: The Battle
episodes.synopsis: Haruka's worse nightmare comes true; Karasu and Fukurou start their dreadful battle, and she does not even know where to find them.

episodes.title: The Wish
episodes.synopsis: Karasu has been severely injured as a result of the previous battle. Haruka and Tobi see to it that he gets the proper amount of Layze to heal himself, but Kosagi does her best to prevent it from happening.

episodes.title: Memories
episodes.synopsis: Haruka visits various time-spaces in the space to see moments within her parent's past through the old telephone that hangs below the stairs.

episodes.title: Shangri-la
episodes.synopsis: Haruka goes on her date with her dad, but it's cut a little short due to work. Though she is asked out on another date by the all-knowing being Noein.

episodes.title: Repeat
episodes.synopsis: Haruka goes down through memory lane, but gets herself literally stuck in the past.

episodes.title: Dilemma
episodes.synopsis: Ai's parents are going to have their wedding ceremony, and Haruka is going to attend it, but she is stopped by Kosagi, who came to finish off what she had started before.

episodes.title: Nightmare
episodes.synopsis: Haruka found an old video when she was younger. She looks around the town to find a tape that could hopefully play it, but in the process of it all, raiding units from Shangri-la have appeared, and Kuina has exploited his allegiance to Shangri-la.

episodes.title: Reminiscence
episodes.synopsis: Haruka deals with the concept of forgetting, as her memories of her grandmother are disappearing, and an old friend she had in Tokyo is unable to recognize her.

episodes.title: Once More
episodes.synopsis: Yuu and Haruka were transported to La'cryma, and were quickly met by the heads of the Dragon Knights. Thanks to Haruka, the two were able to escape. However, Yuu mysteriously disappears off into Shangri-la.

episodes.title: Illusion
episodes.synopsis: Haruka agrees to submit herself to Noein in order to save Yuu and Karasu. Mysteriously, her house and her friends have appeared within the misty grasses of Shangri-la

episodes.title: To the Future
episodes.synopsis: Noein tries to manipulate Haruka into bending her will into his desires by showing her, through Ai, Isami, and Miho, the future they would have had if it remained untouched.

episodes.title: The End
episodes.synopsis: Noein reveals his identity to Haruka, and shares with her his views on life, as well as how his sorrow originated. The Magic Circle Project is also swinging into full motion.

episodes.title: The Beginning
episodes.synopsis: Noein has possessed Haruka's abilities as a dragon torque, though Yuu and Karasu come to her rescue.

info.title: Super Cube
info.synopsis:
In seguito a un incidente, Wang Xiaoxiu, un ragazzo comune, entra in possesso di un sistema spaziale chiamato "Superpower Cube", dono di una civiltà cosmica avanzata. Grazie a esso, ottiene abilità straordinarie. Quando Shen Yao, la ragazza più popolare della scuola e suo amore segreto, gli confessa i suoi sentimenti, il bullo Sun Jun, anch'egli innamorato di lei, si scatena contro di lui.

Wang Xiaoxiu affronta la minaccia con astuzia e poteri sovrumani, ma la vittoria attira conseguenze inaspettate: Shen Yao viene rapita da una figura misteriosa e portata in un mondo di esseri straordinari. Determinato a salvarla, Wang Xiaoxiu intraprende un viaggio epico attraverso un universo bizzarro e pericoloso.

Tra battaglie cosmiche e prove insidiose, scoprirà il vero significato della giustizia e del coraggio, mentre si trasforma in un guerriero senza rivali.

Un’avventura mozzafiato tra amore, potere e destino.

episodes.title: Super A Reincarnation? The goddess confessed to me!
episodes.synopsis: Xiaoxiu Wang, an ordinary student, is thrilled when his childhood friend Yao Shen, with whom he has been in love forever, admits she's interested in him. But this love comes at a price. Jun Sun, the leader of the North District gang, also covets her and has him beaten up by his men and thrown into the river. Just as he's about to drown, he discovers a mysterious glowing cube.

episodes.title: Upgrade! Battle 5? Not to be feared!
episodes.synopsis: After being miraculously saved from the waters by the mysterious cube, Xiaoxiu realizes that it grants him superpowers, such as the ability to teleport. He will have to learn to master them quickly, because Jun and his gang are tenacious and determined to finish him off.

episodes.title: Melee! Is Wang Xiaoxiu still human?
episodes.synopsis: Feeling empowered by his newfound powers, Xiaoxiu decides to take on the North District gang to protect Yao. But when he arrives at the gym where Jun has arranged to meet him, he finds himself facing thirteen seasoned fighters against whom he has little chance of winning alone. Will his superpowers be enough?

episodes.title: Kidnapping? Demon present!
episodes.synopsis: Feeling empowered by his newfound powers, Xiaoxiu decides to take on the North District gang to protect Yao. But when he arrives at the gym where Jun has arranged to meet him, he finds himself facing thirteen seasoned fighters against whom he has little chance of winning alone. Will his superpowers be enough?

episodes.title: G.I. Joe Tower Climb: Wheel of Fortune
episodes.synopsis: Luo Yan, a young mafia boss, has taken Yao hostage to lure Qin Xigu, the man who saved her as a child. But the first to arrive on the scene is Xiaoxiu, and he's determined to save his girlfriend by any means necessary. Will he be able to defeat the highly trained mercenaries hired by Luo?

episodes.title: G.I. Joe Tower Climb: Monster Girl
episodes.synopsis: After defeating three members of the Martial Arts Alliance, Xiaoxiu is about to face two of its most powerful representatives, Jialin and Stone. Will he be able to defeat them and save Yao?

episodes.title: G.I. Joe Tower Climb: Funding for Explosive Fights
episodes.synopsis: Xiaoxiu is now very close to his goal. With Qin Xigu eliminating the penultimate obstacle in his path, all that remains is for the young man to defeat Mushan Chu. But the puppeteer is a devious and particularly tough opponent. Will he be able to defeat him and save Yao?

episodes.title: Being Tricked By A Black-Hearted Agent Into Working As A Bodyguard
episodes.synopsis: Xiaoxiu has lost Yao, the ability to speak to the cube, and any means of finding Luo Yan and Qin Xigu. Desperate, he is approached by a woman who claims to know where Luo is. Who is she? And what exactly does she want?

episodes.title: Rudra's Feast: Warriors and Golden Bells
episodes.synopsis: Xiaoxiu has been recruited by Yuqian Mu, head of the Superhuman Supervision Unit, to protect a VIP in exchange for information on Luo Yan and Qin Xigu. But his mission will prove even more complex and dangerous than his bodyguard contract suggested...

episodes.title: Rudra's Feast: The Real Employer
episodes.synopsis: After a genetically modified crocodile as an appetizer, Weibang Du serves his guests an even tougher second course. But Xiaoxiu notices some unusual behavior among his team, and things quickly escalate. What is Mr. Piao and the other bodyguards' real purpose at this banquet?

episodes.title: Rudra's Feast: The Strength of the Young Lady
episodes.synopsis: After battling a genetically modified crocodile as an appetizer, Weibang Du serves his guests an even tougher second course. But Xiaoxiu notices some unusual behavior among his team, and things quickly escalate. What is Mr. Piao and the other bodyguards' real purpose at this banquet?

info.title: Übel Blatt (ITA)
info.synopsis: In tutto il paese circolano delle voci: quando chi brandisce la spada nera estrae la sua lama, chiunque si trovi sulla sua strada viene fatto a pezzi! Köinzell è il misterioso ragazzo che brandisce questa spada con abilità, ma può essere veramente il responsabile di tutte le sanguinose voci che circolano? Tra la storia sulle Lance Traditrici, quattro potenti guerrieri che si pensava fossero stati sconfitti dai Sette Eroi, e questi ultimi, la forza del giovane verrà messa alla prova fino al limite. Alla fine della battaglia, solo la scioccante verità rimarrà sopra i cadaveri dei suoi nemici...

episodes.title: Durch Bruch (Break Through)
episodes.synopsis: Blatt Meister Ascheriit was slain by his allies and was branded a traitor. Now, 20 years later, he is back with a new name, Köinzell, and a thirst for vengeance. Köinzell arrives at the border wall, Thousand Stonespears, at the Border City of Rielde-Velem. Here, he sets about infiltrating an underground monastery of corrupt monks.

episodes.title: Unter Morgen Monde (Under the Morning Moons)
episodes.synopsis: During a deadly exchange against Rangzatz, Köinzell is thrust down to the depths of the underground monastery. However, Köinzell had visited this fortress with Ergnach in the past. And now, as Köinzell fends off the elite warrior monks, he releases the magic circle spell his comrade had once sacrificed his life to conjure.

episodes.title: Langer Regen (The Long Rain)
episodes.synopsis: When Köinzell reaches the Seven Heroes' encampment, he is forced to confront the immense power and glory his former comrades have amassed since they murdered him in cold blood. Despondent, Köinzell is standing in the rain when a masked avenger makes an attempt on his life.

episodes.title: Koinzell
episodes.synopsis: Chiliarch Fargo invites Wied and Aht to the mayor's manor at night. That night, the two are met by a horde of undead bandits risen through dark Wischtechian magic. Simultaneously, Fargo launches a brutal assault on the refugees, including Peepi. Under the moonlit sky, Köinzell unleashes the power of his Black Sword.

episodes.title: Die Burg vom Helden (The Castle of the Hero)
episodes.synopsis: Schtemwölech welcomes Köinzell's assault with a powerful blast from Dragon's Maw, a Wischtechian magic artillery. Köinzell diverts its attack and breaches the defenses of the castle.Inside, Geranpen is faced with the ultimate choice: either remain loyal to his Lord or seek out the truth.

episodes.title: Schtemwolech
episodes.synopsis: In the depths of the castle altar, Schtemwölech had been conducting vile experiments on demihuman girls. By infusing fairyblood to his, the landgrave had attained a physique of steel through a Wischtechian ritual. Now, Köinzell must confront this former friend to put an end to his twisted plan.

episodes.title: Der leere Sarg (The Empty Coffin)
episodes.synopsis: A state funeral is held to pay tribute to Schtemwölech's glorious rule. Peepi and Altea reconvene with Köinzell, who had taken shelter in the mountains. As the company watch the funeral procession lay the landgrave's coffin to rest at the sacred burial site, Köinzell vows vengeance against the six remaining heroes.

episodes.title: Der Heldmorder (The Hero-Killer)
episodes.synopsis: In a fit of paranoia, the deranged Batterygrave Barestar commands his men to search for the Hero-Killer in the Free City Jullas-Abllas, where Köinzell sought shelter. Meanwhile, under Glenn's leadership, Elsaria's company hunts for the treacherous rebel.

episodes.title: Junge Blatter (Young Leaves)
episodes.synopsis: At the Hall of Swords, Glenn entrusts a manhunt mission to Ichfeis, a slave knight vying to restore the title Blatt Meister. Meanwhile, in the Free City Jullas-Abllas, Köinzell's fight against Elsaria and company takes a desperate turn. Eager to prove herself, Aht recklessly charges in, only to sustain an injury.

episodes.title: Gegenangriff (Counterattack)
episodes.synopsis: Köinzell's stand against the batterygrave's military inspires the townsfolks of Jullas-Abllas to take up arms. Their bravery even convinces Elsaria, the Elector's daughter, to side with the Free City. Just as the tides are about to turn in Köinzell's favor, a powerful blast from a magic artillery cuts through the sky.

episodes.title: Gefuhl zu... (With Feeling)
episodes.synopsis: As Barestar's Floating Castle and magic artillery wreak havoc on all, the people recognize Köinzell's stand to protect the city and call him for what he is, a hero. Meanwhile, Elsaria and company thwart Barestar's men from snatching Marquis Glenn's latest Flagship of the Dragon Airship Fleet, and launch a counteroffensive.

episodes.title: Neues Schwert (New Sword)
episodes.synopsis: Ichfeis, a slave knight who seeks to earn his freedom, faces Köinzell the Hero-Killer in a fated duel. As they cross blades, Ichfeis coaxes Köinzell to launch the Black Wing, the crowning technique of Ludift-style swordsmanship, and delivers his own imperfect rendition. Köinzell strikes back with a magnificent assault.

info.title: Fantazoo (ITA)
info.synopsis: Trasposizione animata di una serie olandese di fumetti a strisce, ancora oggi pubblicata da diversi quotidiani e settimanali dei Paesi Bassi, intitolata Ox Tales (traducibile letteralmente dall'inglese come I racconti del bue) e creata da Wil Raymakers e Thijs Wilms. In un mondo di matrice agreste dove la natura è incontaminata e popolata di ogni sorta di animale antropomorfo, si svolgono le esileranti avventure di un bue e della sua amica tartaruga Alvaro è un gran lavoratore, forte, ingegnoso e sempre carico di ottimismo. Il bue (conosciuto con il nome di Alvaro nell'edizione italiana) è amolto altruista, ma il più delle volte nel tentativo di aiutare gli altri animali del bosco finisce per complicare la vita a tutti, compreso se stesso creando situazioni comiche che lo vedono, suo malgrado, protagonista.

info.title: Fireball
info.synopsis: La serie si svolge nel 47° millennio e ruota intorno a due robot che abitano in una gigantesca villa; la duchessa ginoide Drossel von Flügel e il suo massiccio servitore aracnoide ciclopico, Gedächtnis. Drossel è stato fabbricato con la mente di una ragazza di 14 anni mentre Gedächtnis con la mente di un uomo sui 50 anni sebbene entrambi siano noti per avere almeno 2.800 anni. Nel corso della storia si scopre che Gedächtnis è legato alla famiglia von Flugel da 2.800 anni e che era suo dovere rimanere al fianco di Drossel per tutto quel tempo. Durante il corso degli eventi, i protagonisti stringono un'amicizia con Schadenfreude, robot simile ad una scimmia, dove quest'ultimo si unisce al gruppo dei due robot.

Although they have drifted apart, her feelings remain unchanged. When they are paired up to help prepare for the sports festival, Sae’s long-hidden first love begins to stir once more.

episodes.title: Call My Name
episodes.synopsis: Sae and Kamishiro end up in the same high school and class. Assigned to the same group for trash pickup, Kamishiro gets into a sudden argument with a classmate. As Sae steps in, he instinctively calls her by her first name, bringing back a flood of childhood memories. Meanwhile, another girl, Hisui, seems to be drawn to Kamishiro as well.

episodes.title: No Matter How Far
episodes.synopsis: Knowing Kamishiro has a crush on someone weighs heavily on Sae’s heart. Still, during their school trip, Sae finds herself unable to take her eyes off him. Her friends, Hisui and Kagawa, try their best to support her, but Sae always ends up showing her awkward side around Kamishiro.

episodes.title: He`s Still There Even When I Close My Eyes
episodes.synopsis: Kamishiro admits to Sae that he has feelings for someone, describing his crush as "a star that shines brighter than the sun." The words pierce her heart, but she chooses to support him nonetheless. All the same, as Kamishiro continues to treat Sae just like always, she finds herself torn between her feelings and her resolve.

episodes.title: Jumping and Swinging
episodes.synopsis: After the school trip, a class-versus-class jump rope tournament is set to take place, and Sae and Kamishiro are chosen to swing the rope. Despite the unexpected pairing, Sae tries not to be too conscious of Kamishiro. As practice begins, things do not go as smoothly as expected. One day after school, Sae spots Kagawa practicing alone behind the school building.

episodes.title: Brains, Heart, and Courage
episodes.synopsis: One day, Sae takes a day off from school. The next day, Kamishiro gets injured during club practice and also takes a day off. As they lend each other their notebooks to catch up on missed classes, they begin exchanging messages. A small incident leads Kamishiro to realize that Sae likes someone. Unaware of Sae's true feelings, he encourages her to go for it.

episodes.title: Sun-Shower
episodes.synopsis: Kamishiro is selected as one of the main cast members for the class play. Struggling with his lines, he turns to Sae for help. As they rehearse, they make a promise to go see a movie together during summer break. On the big day, the class's performance is going smoothly until Sae suddenly bursts onto the stage.

episodes.title: Ten Years
episodes.synopsis: With school events behind her, Sae throws herself into club activities. Just then, the date for her long-awaited movie outing with Kamishiro is set. However, a chance encounter with Kamishiro's cousin, Subaru, leaves Sae feeling uneasy, as something Kamishiro once said about his crush comes back to her.

episodes.title: Someone`s Feelings
episodes.synopsis: After their movie date, Sae once again realizes that unless she expresses her feelings, Kamishiro will never notice them. Learning from Hisui that the school festival is a time for love confessions, she decides to tell him during the after-party. While preparing for the event, Sae finds Subaru's painting vandalized, and the situation makes her look like the culprit.

episodes.title: Rumors
episodes.synopsis: As preparations for the class exhibit progress, Sae tries to talk to Kamishiro, but the timing never seems right. On top of that, Hisui points out that she has been spending most of her time with Ayukawa. Just when Sae decides to be more proactive, Kamishiro makes an unexpected proposal.

episodes.title: A Star Without a Constellation
episodes.synopsis: Worried about Subaru, Sae visits the nurse's office. There, Kamishiro notices Subaru trying to act fine and offers to help during the school festival. Sae feels a twinge of loneliness, as she had planned to confess her feelings to him then. However, Kamishiro makes it clear that he will not be available during his reception desk shift with Sae.

episodes.title: A Star Brighter Than the Sun
episodes.synopsis: After hearing that Kamishiro plans to confess to the person he likes, Sae impulsively blurts out her feelings to him. Overcome with emotion, she runs away, convinced she has been rejected. She hides in the gym storage room, crying until the door slowly opens and Kamishiro appears.

info.title: Unexpectedly Naughty Fukami
info.synopsis: Kaji è una persona benvoluta da tutti, ma in realtà disprezza le persone e di nascosto le valuta. Durante un viaggio di lavoro viene accompagnato da Fukami, un collega che si veste in maniera così trasandata da ricevere uno zero come valutazione. Tuttavia dopo un bagno, la valutazione su Fukami cambia completamente! Inizia così la storia fra un playboy narcisista e un otaku dal corpo attraente...

info.title: Psycho Armor Govarian
info.synopsis: Nel bel mezzo di un'invasione su larga scala da parte di alieni extra-dimensionali, lo scienziato ribelle alieno Zeku riunisce un gruppo di adolescenti dotati di vari poteri psichici, tra cui Isamu. Una volta a bordo della nave di Zeku… e abbracciata la sua missione di difendere la razza umana dall'estinzione… Isamu e i suoi compagni utilizzano l'energia mentale per creare enormi armature con cui combattere l'Impero Garadain. Nel corso della serie, i membri del gruppo si scontrano tra loro, si innamorano e combattono ovunque sia necessario per proteggere la Terra, che sia a casa, nello spazio profondo o persino mentre sono intrappolati sul pianeta alieno stesso.

info.title: The Ramparts of Ice (ITA)
info.synopsis: Socialmente incapace di relazionarsi con gli altri, Koyuki Hikawa crea un muro fra lei e le persone che la circondano. Trascorre il suo tempo al liceo in solitudine fino a quando non incontra Minato Amemiya, un ragazzo che cerca di accorciare la distanza tra loro per qualche motivo. Koyuki e Minato, la popolare Miki e il gentile Yōta, questa è la storia di quattro giovani un po' complicati che sono confusi dalle proprie vite!

episodes.title: Lines and Walls
episodes.synopsis: After her classmates run off in fear, Koyuki makes faces in a mirror to figure out why everyone finds her scary. Suddenly, a boy sneaks up behind her.

episodes.title: Locksmith
episodes.synopsis: To Koyuki's relief, Yota comes to her rescue. After their initial study session, they grow more comfortable with each other — which unsettles Minato.

episodes.title: 3+(<-)1
episodes.synopsis: Bothered that Koyuki still has her guard up around him, Minato tries to make small talk. As Miki grows suspicious of his intentions, she confronts him.

episodes.title: Impenetrable
episodes.synopsis: At Miki's prodding, Minato clarifies his interest in her best friend. An unexpected visitor triggers Koyuki's bad memories, leading to a harsh outburst.

episodes.title: Change
episodes.synopsis: Koyuki mulls over the tense exchange in the infirmary. After Yota clears the air, she tries to have an honest conversation with Minato for the first time.

episodes.title: New Semester
episodes.synopsis: As winter break ends, the usually calm Minato begins to realize his feelings are changing. Miki notices how close Yota and Koyuki have become.

episodes.title: Loneliness and Solitude
episodes.synopsis: After reflecting on her own loneliness and worrying that Yota is bottling everything up, Koyuki reaches out and asks about his true feelings.

episodes.title: On Equal Footing
episodes.synopsis: Determined not to mess up high school, Miki has faked her persona since day one. But not being herself around her classmates starts to wear her down.

episodes.title: Self-awareness
episodes.synopsis: Minato realizes how Koyuki is always on his mind. Later, while hanging out at the new mall, the misunderstanding between the four friends deepens.

episodes.title: Spring
episodes.synopsis: A spring break trip to the amusement park brings the four friends closer. Back at school, Koyuki's surprised by a familiar face — and Minato takes notice.

episodes.title: Inversion
episodes.synopsis: Koyuki broods over her complicated past with Akine's sister, Manatsu, and what the first year might know. Meanwhile, Momoka sets her sights on Minato.

episodes.title: Thunder
episodes.synopsis: As Koyuki slowly notices her new, surprising feelings towards Minato, first-year Momoka suddenly tries to cozy up to her — for reasons she can't grasp.

episodes.title: Perception
episodes.synopsis: With Akine's words ringing in her head, Koyuki's feelings become complicated. Later, an accident causes something to shift between Miki and Yota.

episodes.title: Bombshell
episodes.synopsis: Unsure of how to move forward, Miki avoids Yota and confides in her colleagues. A bold Momoka confronts Koyuki about Minato and lights a fuse.

info.title: Horimiya (ITA)
info.synopsis: Hori può sembrare un'ordinaria adolescente, ma in realtà è una persona completamente diversa dopo la scuola: in assenza dei suoi genitori lavoro-dipendenti, Hori è stata come una madre per il fratellino sin da quando era piccola. Tra il prendersi cura del fratello, sfamare entrambi, e sbrigare le faccende domestiche, non ha molto tempo per una normale vita da adolescente. Un giorno incontra qualcun altro che non è quello che sembra a scuola: un tranquillo, occhialuto ragazzo di nome Miyamura. Le aveva dato l'impressione di un topo di biblioteca, e forse di un otaku, ma Hori non poteva sbagliarsi di più. Al di fuori della scuola, Miyamura è un ragazzo socievole con una marea di piercing e per giunta non è nemmeno molto bravo nello studio. Ora i due hanno qualcuno con cui condividere le due metà celate della propria vita!

episodes.title: A Tiny Happenstance
episodes.synopsis: Hori-san lives a double life: trendy, popular girl at school, simple, strong-willed caretaker at home. After a chance encounter with her classmate Miyamura, she finds out that she's not the only one who hides her true self away.

episodes.title: You Wear More Than One Face
episodes.synopsis: When her mother asks about Miyamura, Hori comes to a frightening realization. Later, the Student Council ropes Hori into extra work, but when conflict arises, it's up to Miyamura to smooth things over.

episodes.title: That`s Why It`s Okay
episodes.synopsis: Miyamura reflects on his past and present. Hori responds to Remi's selfish demand. A heated conversation between Ishikawa and Miyamura ends with a fistfight.

episodes.title: Everybody Loves Somebody
episodes.synopsis: The student council room becomes a cool hangout. Hori tries to get Miyamura flustered. An old friend brings out a new side of Miyamura. Later, when Hori gets sick, Miyamura comes to her rescue.

episodes.title: I Can`t Say It Out Loud
episodes.synopsis: A rumor complicates Hori and Miyamura's budding relationship. Kyosuke comes home to roost and instantly takes a liking to Miyamura. Sakura evaluates her friendship with Remi.

episodes.title: This Summer`s Going to Be a Hot One
episodes.synopsis: Miyamura ends up staying the night. Rumors spread like wildfire at school. Shindo calls the couple over to share a bag of candy. A second-year girl begins to stalk Miyamura.

episodes.title: You`re Here, I`m Here
episodes.synopsis: Sakura finds the courage to get closer to Toru. Yoshikawa struggles to voice what she truly wants. Miyamura goes away for a week-long trip. Hori worries about her horror obsession.

episodes.title: The Truth Deception Reveals
episodes.synopsis: Remi reflects on how she and Sengoku started dating. Miyamura discovers a hidden side of Hori. When Yoshikawa gets asked out, the gang gets Ishikawa to help.

episodes.title: It`s Hard, but Not Impossible
episodes.synopsis: Miyamura runs into some unfriendly faces. Hori tries to get Miyamura to fulfill her darkest desires. Mizouchi's love is unrequited. Tanihara confronts his past with Miyamura.

episodes.title: Until the Snow Melts
episodes.synopsis: Hori has an unexpected demand of Miyamura. When Yoshikawa learns her fake relationship with Ishikawa might be coming to an end, she's forced to reflect on her own feelings.

episodes.title: It May Seem Like Hate
episodes.synopsis: The gang tries to get Yanagi to loosen up. Iura is clueless as to how much he terrifies Sawada. When Iura's sister Motoko is struggling with entrance exams, Iura asks Hori to help.

episodes.title: Hitherto, and Forevermore
episodes.synopsis: Yoshikawa heads over to Ishikawa's house. Christmas brings romantic holiday cheer to all. Hori and Miyamura discuss their future.

episodes.title: I Would Gift You the Sky
episodes.synopsis: As graduation approaches, Miyamura reflects on the past year, an uncertain future, and the new life he's found.

info.title: Magilumiere Magical Girls Inc. 2
info.synopsis: Seconda stagione di Magilumiere Magical Girls Inc.

episodes.title: A Legitimate Job Admired by Everyone
episodes.synopsis: At a conference among industry leaders in Kaii countermeasures, Shigemoto's "Alice System" is rejected due to lack of proven results. He takes on a massive yet dangerous new project for himself to prove his abilities while questioning the industry's power dynamics and expectations. Meanwhile, a certain individual approaches Koshigaya with a suspicious proposal, putting her father on shaky ground.

episodes.title: No Logical Means of Exterminating This Kaii
episodes.synopsis: Kana and Koshigaya visit the RIMT to investigate and exterminate a new Kaii species. Guided by Vice Chief Akasaka, they face a bewildering and seemingly invincible Kaii specimen defying all common sense. Behind the scenes, ulterior motives surrounding magic power regulations cause tension as the Kaii unexpectedly mutates. With a strict time limit, Magilumiere's skills are put to the test.

episodes.title: Haven`t Seen Delusion Like This in Ages
episodes.synopsis: Magical Girls from Magilumiere and AST simultaneously face a rampaging new Kaii species. Koshigaya extends an olive branch to Tsuchiba, resulting in a clash of opinions that only sparks tension between their companies. The unknown Kaii rapidly mutates under the influence of magic power, after which a certain individual takes control as operator for the do-or-die battle ahead.

episodes.title: How Exceptional His Magical Girls Are
episodes.synopsis: An improvised collaboration between Magilumiere and AST engages in a do-or-die fight against the rapidly mutating Class C Kaii. Magilumiere's fluctuating defensive and offensive tactics upset conventional methods as Kana gathers real-time data during battle to take control. Through physicality, precise control, and high-level guidance, the seemingly unbalanced team devises a plan to counterattack.

episodes.title: Can`t Keep Acting Like a Rookie
episodes.synopsis: Magilumiere begins recruiting engineers to promote the Alice System. Kana struggles to convey the company's appeal while overseeing the interview process. This causes unexpected personnel to assemble, bringing the team a fresh atmosphere. When securing more talent proves difficult after serious attempts to strengthen their combat potential, Magilumiere heads to Kyoto for lectures and interviews.

episodes.title: You`re Not Fit for This Job
episodes.synopsis: In Kyoto, Magilumiere meets engineer candidate Yamimori, who boasts impressive skills but struggles with cooperation. While compatibility with the team is called into question, he appears to be hiding certain feelings about his childhood friend Sakae and his personal values. Meanwhile, during a festival at Tonomori Shrine, a ritual unleashes a Kaii while an ominous shadow lurks behind the scenes.

episodes.title: The Battle`s Already Over
episodes.synopsis: At the Tonomori Shrine ceremony's climax, an unknown Kaii suddenly invades a barrier once believed to be safe, enveloping the area in chaos. The barrier blocks outside forces, which separates Magilumiere's team. Makino and Akasaka are forced into a struggle within the barrier while Nikoyama searches for an opening outside. With time running out, each decision will greatly influence the outcome.

episodes.title: You Can Choose Where to Grow Up
episodes.synopsis: After gaining the trust of his allies, Yamimori takes action to fight the rampaging Kaii inside the sealed barrier. Makino and Akasaka also rechallenge the front lines to face the now-overpowered Kaii with harmonious teamwork and quick thinking. The dire situation demonstrates the skill and trust between Magical Girls and their engineers as the team marches onward with full hearts.

episodes.title: Are You Expecting Us to Sugarcoat This?
episodes.synopsis: The Kaii at Tonomori is revealed to be someone's act of sabotage promoting a scheme to ease magic regulations behind the scenes and manipulate public opinion. Then, the culprit emerges-someone entirely unexpected. While Yamimori becomes comfortable at Magilumiere, Kana decides to confront major industry norms and her own role in the process, sparking the onset of war on a much grander scale.

episodes.title: Do You Like Barley Spice?
episodes.synopsis: While deregulation advocates plot their next scheme, Magilumiere defies all precedents by waiting to ambush an enormous, unclassified, and highly irregular Kaii before it emerges. Koshigaya, Akasaka, and Makino struggle on the field as the Kaii's power escalates beyond all expectation while Nikoyama and Yamimori frantically work together on analysis and support from the operator's chair.

episodes.title: A Job You Can Bail on Has No Value
episodes.synopsis: As the battle in Tokyo Bay intensifies, Magilumiere's Magical Girls work together to take control. However, Tsuchiba from AST intervenes to turn the battle on its head with her ultra-powerful new magical device—"Wings"—aiming to single-handedly annihilate the target and contradict Magilumiere's cooperative combat style. Now, with tensions flaring, it's not just a fight against the Kaii anymore.

episodes.title: Glad I Became a Magical Girl
episodes.synopsis: Amidst the raging war, Magilumiere and AST finally decide to "cooperate" as Shigemoto gives AST full access to the Alice System's technology to combine both companies' power for shared use among their Magical Girls. Meanwhile, Tsuchiba nearly loses control of her magic. For the sake of future generations, new relationships and moral values drive everyone involved to fight with their hearts.

info.title: Mission: Yozakura Family 2 (ITA)
info.synopsis: Seconda stagione di Mission: Yozakura Family 2

episodes.title: Ai Comes to the Yozakura Family / Mini Kyoichiro
episodes.synopsis: Former Tanpopo executive Ai joins the Yozakura household to reform, but peace is soon threatened.

episodes.title: Winners and Losers
episodes.synopsis: Taiyo faces school chaos as Bronze Rank spy Sosuke Michibata targets him with sabotage and rumors.

episodes.title: The Big Bro Shinzo Safety Watch Team
episodes.synopsis: Shinzo’s shopping trip with Ayaka turns chaotic as Kengo and Nanao secretly assist him.

episodes.title: Spy Advancement Exam
episodes.synopsis: Taiyo faces Shinzo in a brutal game of tag during the first stage of the Spy Exam.

episodes.title: The Fruit of Love
episodes.synopsis: Taiyo faces Kyoichiro in a terrifying final exam stage where examinees vanish into the darkness.

episodes.title: New Cherry Blossoms
episodes.synopsis: Taiyo meets a mutated Kawashita to learn how to kill Tsubomi, but his father-in-law, Momo, appears.

episodes.title: At the Old Yozakura Residence
episodes.synopsis: Mutsumi tests Taiyo’s surging powers while Futaba fails to learn tech skills from Shion.

episodes.title: Ai`s Errand / Mutsumi`s Major Diet Mission
episodes.synopsis: Ai goes on her first solo errand to cheer up the family, while a disguised Taiyo and Mutsumi follow.

episodes.title: Tsubomi & Mutsumi
episodes.synopsis: The Yozakuras' search for an ancient journal turns into a chaotic and revealing mansion cleanup.

episodes.title: Refusal
episodes.synopsis: Kyoichiro vanishes, but Taiyo’s date is cut short by a mysterious presence and an urgent summons.

episodes.title: Operation Search for the Eldest Son
episodes.synopsis: Taiyo finds Kyoichiro, who rejects the family and flees, causing a rift among the siblings.

episodes.title: Let`s Be a Family Again
episodes.synopsis: Poisoned by Tsubomi, Kyoichiro flees to save his family. Taiyo desperately chases him to save him.

info.title: Your Letter
info.synopsis: Sori è una ragazza gentile, premurosa e di sani principi. Sfortunatamente queste sue qualità la rendono anche bersaglio perfetto di bullismo. Si trasferisce quindi in una nuova scuola, e quando sembra che la storia stia per ripetersi, si imbatte in una misteriosa serie di lettere che la condurranno in una magica caccia al tesoro, in un mondo nascosto, sotto la superficie della sua nuova scuola. Un'avventura che la porterà a riscoprire l'amicizia, le meraviglie della natura e la bontà dell'umanità.
